🚨 Bombay High Court Halts Further Demolition of Dawood Ibrahim-Linked Building in Mumbai The Bombay High Court on November 19 ordered a halt to further demolition of Haji Ismail Haji Habib Musafirkhana in Bhendi Bazaar, Mumbai, directing all parties to maintain status quo until November 25. The building, reportedly associated with Dawood Ibrahim's family , houses a nearly 150-year-old prayer hall . The BMC had classified the structure as dangerous and begun demolition before the court intervened. The dispute involves the property's Waqf status , with an appeal pending before the Waqf Tribunal.
